finish_message: Phase 3 MindMap canvas, synchronized outline, and multi-pane workspace implementation is complete and pushed.
summary: Added hierarchical tree layout and viewport geometry, an interactive pannable/zoomable MindMap canvas with card nodes, mini-map, folding, persisted movement/reparenting and relation links, a synchronized outline with filtering and hierarchy actions, unified selection across PDF/MindMap/Outline, multi-pane workspace modes, and unit tests for layout, folding, viewport transforms, and database tree mutations.
notes: The implementation targets macOS SwiftUI/AppKit/CoreGraphics. The available execution environment here does not provide the macOS SDK, so swift test and swift build were not run locally; the orchestrator should run both validation commands on macOS.
